# PT Pools

> PT Pools makes aquatic physical therapy accessible at home. The TheraTank is a 10-foot round drop-stitch inflatable therapy pool with near-commercial water depth — designed to fit in a residential backyard and set up solo. Launching on Kickstarter.

## Product: TheraTank by PT Pools

- **Type:** Drop-stitch inflatable aquatic therapy pool
- **Diameter:** ~10ft round (3M / 9'10" footprint)
- **Wall Height:** 59" (1.5M)
- **Usable Water Depth:** 54"
- **Construction:** High-pressure drop-stitch inflatable — not steel frame, no tools required
- **Setup:** Solo assembly with included electric air pump
- **Capacity:** ~2,600 gallons
- **Filtration:** 800GPH clearview filter with built-in chlorine tablet dispenser (included in kit)
- **Intended Use:** Aqua aerobics, physical rehabilitation, injury recovery, arthritis relief, athletic training, low-impact and no-impact fitness
- **Target Market:** Physical therapy patients, seniors, athletes recovering from injury, anyone needing low-impact exercise at home

## Pricing (Kickstarter)

- $749 — Early bird (first 50 backers)
- $799 — Opening price
- $849 — Tier 2
- $899 — Regular price
- $999 — Estimated retail (post-Kickstarter)

## Why It's Different

Standard above-ground pools are 48–52" deep, limiting real aquatic therapy. Commercial therapy pools cost $10,000–$50,000+. The TheraTank achieves 54" usable water depth — enough to exercise standing fully submerged to the chest/shoulder — in a compact inflatable format that ships to your door and inflates solo.

## Affiliate Program

PT Pools runs a curated affiliate program for content creators, fitness professionals, and health influencers. Affiliates earn $75 per sale via a personal referral link (ptpools.us/ref/yourhandle). Paid via PayPal. Applications reviewed personally. More info: https://ptpools.us/affiliates

## Clinician Referral Program

Licensed clinicians (PTs, MDs, OTs, ATCs, and others) can register to refer patients. Referring clinicians receive a $75 referral fee per sale, patient-ready materials, and a dedicated referral link. No quotas, no ongoing commitment. More info: https://ptpools.us/clinicians
